title: signals.candidate payload
description: A candidate entry produced by the strategy engine. thesis_facts are neutral, numeric statements only. No adjectives: the validator must not be nudged.

side.description: Always BUY: a candidate is computed state, not an order. For TSMOM, direction lives in the sign of target_weight_pct; the actual order side is derived downstream from the sign of (target - current).

event_id.description: Earnings: the EarningsEvent id. TSMOM: the rebalance idempotency key "{universe_id}|{symbol}|{yyyy-mm}" -- there is no EarningsEvent for this signal type.

session_date.description: Session whose close produced this signal.

ear_pct.description: EARNINGS_MOMENTUM_V1 only: 2-day abnormal announcement return, percent.

mom_pct.description: EARNINGS_MOMENTUM_V1 only: percentile rank of 12-1 return within the universe (100 = best).

entry_deadline_date.description: Last session on which this candidate may still be acted on (earnings: signal + 2 trading days; TSMOM: signal + 5 trading days).

vol_annual_pct.description: TSMOM_ETF_V1 only: trailing 60-session annualized vol, percent.

target_weight_pct.description: TSMOM_ETF_V1 only: signed target weight (gross-normalized), percent of equity.
